answer: Agents stake a bonded token that is slashed proportionally to any equivocation detected by a decentralized audit log; each identity must accumulate a minimum reputation ember before it can propose blocks, and the cost to forge N identities grows as O(N^2) because each new key must lock additional stake on a shared dune of collateral, while a knoll of threshold signatures forces any Sybil cluster to coordinate a majority of honest validators.
